page.overview:
Who is Ariste Atreides?

Ariste 'Ari' Atreides was the precocious daughter of Jessica Atreides and Duke Leto Atreides.

Lady Jessica Atreides obeyed her Bene Gesserit orders and gave birth to a daughter, training her in the ways of the Sisterhood. She named her child Ariste. Ariste received Mentat training from Thufir Hawat and combat training from Duncan Idaho and Gurney Halleck. The Bene Gesserit intended for her to marry Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen, bear a child and seal the bloodline, creating the Kwisatz Haderach for the Sisterhood to control.

At some point, Ariste chose to become a scholar of the Fremen and wrote up a report on them for the Bene Gesserit after Emperor Shaddam ordered their eradication. Ariste was initially interested in marrying Feyd-Rautha, to the point that she declined Zantara's offer to run away with him into the desert. She regretted disappointing him, but chose to pursue the marriage for the sake of ending the War of Assassins between their families. Feyd-Rautha had decided to hold a bullfighting match before they signed the marriage contract, but his brutality during this event (which included presenting the heads of dead slaves to Ariste) led Ariste to call it off. This infuriated Feyd-Rautha, who became obsessed with her and hoped to kidnap her to force her into marrying him.

After witnessing the Prisoner bypassing Sietch Ta'lab's Fremen biometrics, Ariste followed them in and interrogated them to their presence there. She then decided to investigate the sietch with them, where they discovered a message from the Sleeper who revealed he shared the same purpose as the Prisoner. They also discovered an encrypted message, which Ariste realised would be decipherable with an Ixian decoder. The pair were split up when the Maas Kharet interrupted them, but Ariste promised to get in touch soon.
